description: Folder mapping of scripts/codemods/split-ai-chatbot.mjs: every file and folder directly under src/modules/ai-chatbot goes to the folder of the first rule whose pattern matches its name. Move only.

folders.ai-id: AI ID (lesson author): V1 legacy (ai-id/legacy/), V2 orchestration, IDM, workspace, sessions, sources, transcription, generation jobs, chapter checkpoints
folders.ai-report: AI Report: report chat turn and router, report PDF (with report-pdf-template/), AI report settings
folders.kb: Knowledge bases: KB CRUD and documents, KB operations queue, upload and restore workers, FAQ sheets, local source content
folders.chat: Chat: learner and admin chat turn (chat.service.ts, SSE stream), conversations, bots, chat admission and stream locks
folders.ai-platform: Shared AI platform: AI settings, secrets, pricing, usage, token quota, metered calls, RAG client, engine transition, Gemini client and File Search store calls, input filter

keep.ai-chatbot.routes.ts: The module's router stays at the module root: app.ts mounts it at /api/ai-chatbot, and it wires the controllers of every sub-folder.
keep.ai-chatbot.routes.golden.test.ts: The router's route-table golden test stays next to it.
keep.ai-chatbot.routes.golden.json: The router's route-table golden stays next to it.
